key_idea: Sort the names by the suffix that starts at the first capital letter, using plain ASCII comparison.
sketch: Read each full line (names contain spaces and apostrophes), find the first character in A-Z and take the suffix from there as the sort key. Sort pairs (key, original) with ordinary byte-wise string comparison and print the originals. O(n log n * |s|). Pitfalls: must use getline rather than token input, strip a possible trailing carriage return, and compare by raw ASCII (space and apostrophe sort before letters, capitals before lowercase) rather than case-insensitively.
